checklist.note: Reviewer: "They have different UI and names". Blind step 1 (2026-11-02, before any evidence, earlier UI wording): chose B as the frozen Report (correct), cue: the words "Report" and "Frozen Report" at the top (as recorded by the owner), confidence: guessing.
